markdown.headingText: Load Niger boundaries map from Humanitarian Data Exchange
markdown.markdown:
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

rm(list = ls())
```

```{r Load packages and config}

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

source(here::here("analysis", "0-config.R"))
```

```{r Load base maps}

# Map downloaded from https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-ner on 10 March 2026

niger_adm1 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "untouched", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin1.shp"))
niger_adm2 <- st_read(dsn = here("data", "untouched", "ner_admin_boundaries", "ner_admin2.shp"))

```

```{r Load data}

df_all <- readRDS(here("data","grappe_mortality_data_all_rands.rds"))

# Project coordinates to UTM so distances are in meters, not degrees

d_sf <- df_all %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), crs = global_crs) %>%
  # st_transform(crs = proj_crs) %>% 
  mutate(lon = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,1],
         lat = sf::st_coordinates(.)[,2])

```


```{r Prep data}

# filter admin level 2 subdistricts to just Dosso and Tahoua
niger_adm2 <- niger_adm2 %>%
    filter(adm1_name %in% c("Dosso","Tahoua"))

niger_dists_cr <- st_crop(niger_adm1, xmin = 0, xmax = 7,
                                    ymin = 11, ymax = 19)


```

```{r Plot Niger departments map}

plot_niger_admin <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm1, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    # geom_sf(data=niger_gadm0_sf, color="black",lwd=0.5) +
    coord_sf(crs = global_crs) +
    geom_rect(aes(xmin = 0, xmax = 7, ymin = 11.5, ymax = 19), color = "black", fill = NA, lty = "dashed", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    # add country labels
    annotate("text",x=4,y=22, label = "Niger", fontface="bold",size=8) +
    labs(x="",y="") +
    ylim(c(11, 23)) +
  xlim(c(0, 16)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_blank(),
        axis.line = element_blank(),
        plot.margin = margin(0,0,0,0, "pt")
        )

plot_niger_admin

```

```{r Plot grappes map}

# annotation line
dosso_lab_line <- data.frame(x1=4.47,x2=4.1,y1=12.55,y2=12.7)
tahoua_lab_line <-  data.frame(x1=5.9,x2=5.5,y1=17.9,y2=17.5)

# detailed zoom view, including grappes
plot_grappe_map <- ggplot() +
    # admin boundaries
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm1, fill="white", color="black",lwd=1) + 
    geom_sf(data=niger_adm2, fill="white", color="black",lwd=0.3) +
    # cluster points
    geom_sf(data=d_sf, aes(color=adaptive_rand),size=0.1, alpha=0.9, pch=19) +
    coord_sf(crs = global_crs,
             xlim = c(0, 7), ylim = c(11, 19),
             expand = FALSE) +
    # scale_shape_manual(values=c(15,16,17)) +
    # scale_color_brewer(type="seq") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#FFA400FF", "grey40", "grey70"),
                             breaks = c("Randomization 1", "Randomization 2", "Randomization 3"),
                             labels = c("24 months", "12 months", "6 months"),
                             name = "Follow-up time") +
    # admin labels
    annotate("text",x=6,y=18.2, label = "Tahoua", fontface = "bold", color = "gray80", size=8) + # x=5.2,y=16.2,
    annotate("text",x=5.4,y=12.5, label = "Dosso", fontface = "bold", color = "gray80", size=8) +
    geom_segment(data=dosso_lab_line, aes(x=x1, xend=x2, y=y1, yend=y2), color = "gray80", lwd=0.8, arrow=arrow(angle=30,length=unit(2,"mm"),ends="last",type="open")) +
    geom_segment(data=tahoua_lab_line, aes(x=x1, xend=x2, y=y1, yend=y2), color = "gray80", lwd=0.8, arrow=arrow(angle=30,length=unit(2,"mm"),ends="last",type="open"))  +
    annotation_scale(location = "br", width_hint = 0.3, pad_y=unit(0.1,"cm")) +
    annotation_north_arrow(location = "br", which_north = "true", 
        pad_x = unit(0.05, "in"), pad_y = unit(0.2, "in"),
        height=unit(0.75,"cm"), width=unit(0.75,"cm"),
        style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering
        ) +
    labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude") +
    guides(color=guide_legend(reverse = FALSE, override.aes = list(size=4)))  +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom"
    )

plot_grappe_map


```

```{r Plot map with inset}  

plot_map_with_inset <- plot_grappe_map + 
    inset_element(plot_niger_admin,
                  left = unit(0.15, "npc"), top = unit(1.35, "npc"),
                  bottom = unit(0.28, "npc"), right = unit(0.54, "npc"),
                  ignore_tag = TRUE
    )

# see patch for existing bug in patchwork for geom_sf
# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/18252827/increasing-area-around-plot-area-in-ggplot2
plot_map_with_inset$patches$layout$widths  <- 1
plot_map_with_inset$patches$layout$heights <- 1

plot_map_with_inset

ggsave(here("results", "manuscript", "fig1-context-map.png"),
       plot_map_with_inset,
       device = "png",
       width = 175,
       height = 160,
       units = "mm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```
